failure_definition: Blood pressure monitor calibration drift causing inaccurate readings
causal_mechanism: Calibration drift in blood pressure monitors leads to inaccurate readings over time due to the natural degradation of the calibration over time.
current_device_behavior: The device currently provides blood pressure readings without any automated self-calibration routine.
failure_point: The device fails to maintain accurate readings due to calibration drift during idle periods.
blocking_constraint: The need for a cost-effective and non-invasive solution that does not compromise the device's portability and user-friendliness.
